description: NaZn₂H₃(SO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one NaZn₂H₃(SO₄)₂ sheet oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.83 Å. There are three inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 60-62°. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.21 Å. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 60°. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.25 Å. In the third Zn site, Zn is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ZnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 62°. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 2.12-2.22 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 1.00 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.58 Å. In the second S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and one longer (1.56 Å) S-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Zn and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three Zn and one H atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one S atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one S atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Zn and one S atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Zn, and one S atom to form distorted ONaZn₂S trigonal pyramids that share corners with three ONaZn₂S trigonal pyramids and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂ZnS trigonal pyramid. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Zn, and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂ZnS trigonal pyramids. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one S atom.
